_about: Ticket 21, Product Filtering's store-wide default list (PUT /v3/settings/search/filters): choice 1 on plan/approvals/21-product-filtering.md, the alternative to the recommended choice 2, a channel-wide ReelFlies_CA context, which is the ticket's per-channel route now that probe 6 found per-channel contexts. Fly Sizes first and open, 15 values, sorted by option value (hook order once ticket 18's Fly Sizes job lands); Category hidden; Brand and Price stay hidden; every other filter keeps the values read on 2026-10-06, with the read-only facet fields left out. The order: Fly Sizes, then the other shown filters in the read's order (Other, Rating), then the hidden ones in the read's order. So Rating moves from 5th to 3rd only because the hidden Category, Brand and Price move below it; on a page, Other and Rating keep their order after Fly Sizes. items_to_show is sent as the string BigCommerce's Update Enabled Filters documents ("5", "10", "15"), though the store reads it back as a number. The list takes no channel_id, so it is Shaun's: plan.mjs --approved, then apply.mjs --approved at his terminal; product-filtering.restore.json beside it is its undo. Who it reaches: BigCommerce's Contextual Filters guide says contexts apply to category pages, and brand and search-results pages use this default list. Channels 1 and 1855224 each have a channel-wide context (category_id 0), so their category pages keep their own lists, and a read-only render (stencil start, ?debug=context, GETs only) shows their brand pages with their own context's filters too, not this list (.com's show Price, which this list hides). The render carries no facets for search-results pages, so those are unproven: they may use this list, and on reelflies.ca and reelflies.com would then lose the Category facet and show Fly Sizes first with 15 values by option value. ReelFlies_CA (1895766, no context) gets it on every page. So its only gain over choice 2 is ReelFlies_CA's search results, and its cost is that possible change to the live sites' search results.
